itemJudgments.reason: Relative who takes plural clerks: sort. One of the clerks is singular: holds.

Each of the clerks is singular: keeps. Compound subject Ava and Ben remains plural with each: review.
Only D has agreement: plural assistants sort after nor; A, B, and C each use a singular/plural mismatch.
Most of the letters takes plural include; most of the mass noun mail takes singular arrives.
